title: Access guardrails and evidence workflow for residency & retention controls
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Implement end-to-end access controls and automated evidence generation to satisfy data residency and retention compliance audits. Scope includes RBAC policy model updates, SSO/SAML assertion logging, SCIM provisioning health checks, and a monthly periodic access review export (machine-readable) that can be consumed by auditors. We must ensure the evidence artifacts are tamper-evident, bound to a release, and stored in the compliance bucket with retention metadata. This ticket coordinates the engineering work, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and handoff to Security/Compliance for sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC role bindings model supports tenant-scoped and org-scoped roles with audit trail for every change
SSO/SAML login events store hashed subject and assertion metadata to audit log for at least 1 year
SCIM provisioning exposes a delta-status endpoint and daily health report to detect sync drift
Automated monthly access certification export exists (CSV + signed checksum) and is written to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/ENG-15827/ with timestamps
Evidence artifacts include release tag, schema version, and checksum and are discoverable from the Console Compliance page
implementation_notes: Extend authorization service to emit structured audit events for role changes (actor, timestamp, before/after, request_id)
Add SAML assertion metadata capture at the SSO ingress (do not store raw PII; store hashed identifiers and assertion id)
Implement SCIM sync validator microjob that compares id mappings and reports anomalies to the compliance topic
Create a scheduled Lambda/worker that composes the monthly export and attaches a signed HMAC computed with KMS key

notes_on_tradeoffs: Per-tenant RBAC provides strict isolation but increases policy churn and complexity for support
Storing full SAML assertions would make debugging easier but increases PII risk; chosen approach is hashed identifiers + assertion metadata
SCIM full-sync daily is simpler but costlier; delta + health checks preferred to limit load
testing_plan: Unit tests for RBAC change audit event generation
Integration test simulating SSO flows and verifying hashed identifiers in audit store
End-to-end test that runs the monthly export, verifies checksum/HMAC, and validates Console discovery
Load test SCIM validator against 1M users for performance characterization
risk_mitigation: Feature-gate the export and SCIM validator behind an account-level flag
Rollback playbook documented in Confluence with contact list for manual exports
Alerting on export failures and on audit event ingestion lag > 5 minutes
